verdict.rationale: Modal's Python SDK lets you deploy apps and programmatically interact with the Modal platform, and an official CLI is documented, so much of the platform is code-first. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature: the JS and Go SDKs cover only some platform resources, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a public REST/OpenAPI spec, evidence that UI-only settings such as workspace budgets are reachable via the API, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
The JS and Go SDKs allow you to use Modal Sandboxes, invoke deployed Modal Functions, and interact with some Modal platform resources.
